title: Closed feedback clusters recur into the ranked digest instead of retiring silently
action: In rank_clusters (and cluster_has_closed_entry area, ~line 1890): a cluster carrying a closed entry currently always retires. Change: find the latest closed-entry timestamp (existing entry timestamp field — reuse the same field ranking already reads, ISO string compare); when any non-closed entry in the cluster is strictly newer than it, the cluster is a RECURRENCE — it joins the ranked list (ranking arithmetic unchanged, computed over its non-closed entries) with added fields recurred:true, closed_at:<iso>, recurred_count:<entries newer than close>. Clusters whose closed entry is the newest stay retired exactly as today. Locate the existing tests for rank_clusters/digest (search feedback tests module; the second file path in files is a guess — reserve the real one if it differs) and add: clean retire stays retired, recurrence re-enters ranked with flags, equal-timestamp boundary stays retired. JSON digest shape gains only the new optional fields on recurred clusters.

truths: A closed cluster with no newer entries retires exactly as before
A newer non-closed entry re-enters the cluster into ranked with recurred:true, closed_at, recurred_count
Ranking arithmetic for never-closed clusters is byte-identical
Equal timestamps do not count as recurrence

trace.outcome: Closed feedback clusters recur into the ranked digest when a non-closed entry postdates the close, instead of retiring silently
